d574.Raw_Article: 574 Te. usirika emblic myrobalan. Kol. (SR.) usurkā gooseberry. Go. (ASu.) usirka a tree. Konḍa usrika maran, (Sova dial.) sūrika mrānu , (BB) sūrika maran aonla tree, emblic myrobalan. Pe. hūrka mar id. Manḍ. jūrka id. Kui (K.) jura id. Kuwi (Su. P.) jur'o id. DEDS 71.
